name: Arrowhead Acres Campground

name: Condit's Ranch
evidence: satellite (Esri, 700 m frame) at 41.2128,-89.4126: campground loops under hardwood canopy south of Log Cabin Hill Rd with small ponds among them; no site fronts open water; not waterfront

name: Spring Creek Campground
evidence: satellite (Esri, 700 m frame) at 39.1854,-88.3795: loop of gravel sites in a clearing north of a small farm pond; the pond is ~100 m from the loop behind trees; not waterfront

name: Cozy Corners Campground
evidence: satellite (Esri, 700 m frame) at 41.2946,-89.0089: a few grassy sites around a farmstead at a rural crossroads; no water in frame; not waterfront

name: Glenwood RV Resort
evidence: satellite (Esri, 700 m frame) at 41.3307,-88.6904: trailer lanes in a wooded ravine above Marseilles; no lake or river in view of the sites; not waterfront

name: Clad & Cordon Vineyard RV Camping
evidence: satellite (Esri, 700 m frame) at 37.5473,-88.8338: winery buildings and vineyard rows with a gravel RV area; farm ponds nearby are not fronted by sites; not waterfront

name: Sandwich Fairgrounds RV Campground
evidence: satellite (Esri, 700 m frame) at 41.6516,-88.6343: tree-lined camping grid on the east side of the Sandwich fairgrounds by the racetrack; no water; not waterfront

name: Lake Alexander RV Park

name: Village of New Athens RV Park

name: Bluegill Bay Marina & Campground (Crab Orchard NWR)

name: Oakwood RV Park & Campgrounds
evidence: satellite (Esri, 700 m frame) at 39.5780,-89.4061: gravel RV pad rows north of a residential grid in Kincaid; no water; not waterfront
